name: scott-skills
description: Scott's end-to-end workflow for Claude Code: chart an effort as a wayfinder map from your destination, principles, and high-level design, let agents resolve it — every decision citing its grounds, strain on earlier decisions triggering planned corrections — slice the decisions into shippable specs, review each slice and its spec, break it into tickets, and ship it wave by wave — driven by /next — or grow a feature a slice at a time with /iterate, decisions made just in time against an effort log in the repo and the next effort's idea parked as a ticket by /seed — every review gate on the finding-pipeline contract, every spawned agent on a policy-resolved model tier, every test run scoped to the change by the repo's TESTING.md — plus standalone skills for grilling, design, domain modeling, prototyping, research, TDD, wizards, verification skills that drive each app the way a user does, writing for agents, Herdr and Rex hand-offs and side panes, cold-reading the docs agents have worn, /tend to keep the repo's CONVENTIONS, TESTING, PRINCIPLES, CONTEXT and ADR docs on purpose as each change lands, a /snag → /autopsy loop that traces friction in past sessions back to the skill text that caused it and replays it as an eval, /evals to A/B any skill edit against the text before it, and /maintain-iterate, which tunes the /iterate loop from its own runs.
